welcome.body: Ku soo dhawoow NuunPlatform — madasha waxbarashada Soomaaliyeed ee ardayda dugsiga sare.
welcome.features:
📚 PDF-yada waxbarashada
🎯 Tartamada tooska ah
📊 Horumarkaaga
welcome.cta: Taabo badamada hoos si aad u bilowdo.

subscribe.body: ✅ Waad ku biirtay ogeysiiska tartamada cusub.
subscribe.info: Marka tartan cusub la abuuro, waxaan halkan kugu soo diri doonaa fariin.
subscribe.off_hint: Haddii aad rabto inaad damiso ogeysiiska, ka dami boggaaga: Settings → Notifications.
subscribe.cta: Taabo badamada hoos si aad u gasho bogga.

unknown.cta: Taabo badamada hoos si aad u gasho bogga.

help.title: 📖 Caawinaad
help.list:
• PDF-yada waxbarashada oo bilaash ah
• Tartamo toos ah oo lala tartamo ardayda kale
• Falanqayn iyo horumar gaar ah
help.cta: Taabo badanka hoos si aad bogga u gasho.
help.contact_hint: Haddii aad u baahan tahay caawinaad dheeraad ah, kala xiriir maamulka.

gate.channel_prompt:
📢 Hal tallaabo oo kooban ka hor PDF-kaaga:

Fadlan marka hore ku biir channel-keena.
Kadibna taabo ✅ Waan ku biiray hoosta.
gate.group_prompt:
👥 Ku dhow baad tahay:

Fadlan marka hore ku biir group-keena.
Kadibna taabo ✅ Waan ku biiray hoosta.
gate.not_yet_channel: ❌ Weli ma aadan ku biirin channel-ka. Fadlan ku biir, kadibna taabo ✅ Waan ku biiray.
gate.not_yet_group: ❌ Weli ma aadan ku biirin group-ka. Fadlan ku biir, kadibna taabo ✅ Waan ku biiray.
gate.too_many_attempts: ❗ Isku dayo badan. Fadlan mar kale dir /start <code> si aad dib ugu bilowdo.

pdf.delivery_caption_footer: 🔗 Waxaa laga heli karaa madashayada oo leh waxbarasho dheeraad ah!
pdf.delivery_error: ❌ Waan ka xumahay, ma heli karo PDF-ka. Fadlan isku day mar dambe.
pdf.intake_error: ❌ Ma keydin karo PDF-ka. Fadlan isku day mar dambe.
pdf.duplicate: ⚠️ PDF-kan horey ayaa loo helay (ama la daabacay ama wali sugaya).
